summary: Iteration 27 — Invoice tab overhaul end-to-end test. Backend (billing.py) previously curl-verified by main agent; this pass focused on frontend. All 8 acceptance criteria pass: single '#invoice-print' rule, auto-increment invoice number, status dropdown (In Transit/Paid/Denied) both in editor and inline row, view modal single-invoice render, edit from view modal, edit save resets editor to next number, single + bulk delete without confirm dialog, dashboard filter regression.

issues: Some legacy rows show blank Invoice Number '—' and Patient 'Unknown' — likely pre-existing invoices missing invoice_number/patient_id; cosmetic only. Not part of this task.

critical_code_review_comments: Invoices.js is 460 lines — approaching split threshold; consider extracting the view-modal, editor, saved-list, and note-modal into subcomponents to improve maintainability.

Row status <select> re-derives value with `STATUSES.includes(v.status) ? v.status : 'in_transit'` which silently masks legacy statuses like 'unpaid'/'void' in the UI — user cannot see or restore them from the row select. If that is intentional (only 3 choices going forward) it's fine; otherwise flag legacy statuses (e.g. show them read-only).
seed_data_creation: Created ~4 throwaway invoices during test — ALL deleted at end (verified via bulk_deleted_all=True and delete_removed=True). Pre-existing real invoices preserved.

verified_flows.invoice_print_when_viewing: exactly 1 #invoice-print (inside modal[data-testid=invoice-view]); editor container renamed to #editor-doc — single-invoice print rule satisfied
verified_flows.invoice_print_edit_mode_from_modal: exactly 1 #invoice-print (back to editor after view-edit-btn closes modal)
verified_flows.auto_increment: MB-0028 → MB-0029 after save; another increment after edit-save
verified_flows.edit_from_view_modal: loads invoice into editor with correct number MB-0028 (matches originally-viewed invoice)
verified_flows.editor_reset_after_edit_save: editor advanced to next number (was MB-0028, becomes MB-0029)
verified_flows.single_delete_no_confirm: no native dialog fired (verified via page.on('dialog'))
verified_flows.bulk_delete_no_confirm: no native dialog fired (verified via page.on('dialog'))

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend Invoices tab is fully verified. Test used dialog listener (page.on('dialog')) — that is the reliable way to detect native confirms; overriding window.confirm inside page.evaluate is flaky in this app. The saved list contains legacy rows with missing invoice_number/patient_name shown as '—'/'Unknown' — pre-existing data, not a regression.
